project.scientific_question: When the Q022 CamSpec and CASE-031 HiLLiPoP endpoint results are compared in the same Q031 common-geometry coordinates with the same locked scales, and stable/non-stable is not used as the sole discriminator, is there a material reproducible difference in endpoint geometry that still supports implementation-specific non-portability?

endpoint_identity.semantics: Q022 mask/restart labels are provenance-linked mapped-start identities only; they are not HiLLiPoP masks. Q031 endpoint with label L is matched only to Q022 source endpoint with the same label L.

descriptors.D1_matched_endpoint_rms: For each of the 9 labels, Q031 common RMS between Q022 source endpoint and Q031 HiLLiPoP refined endpoint.
descriptors.D2_location_median: Median of the 9 D1 matched endpoint RMS values.
descriptors.D3_location_exceedance_count: Count of D1 values strictly greater than 0.10.
descriptors.D4_normalized_centroid_shift: Q031 common RMS between the normalized-coordinate centroids of the 9 Q022 and 9 Q031 endpoint sets.
descriptors.D5_pairwise_distance_drift: For each of the 36 unordered label pairs, absolute difference between the Q031 common RMS within Q031 and the Q031 common RMS within Q022.
descriptors.D6_shape_median_drift: Median of the 36 D5 pairwise distance drifts.
descriptors.D7_shape_max_drift: Maximum of the 36 D5 pairwise distance drifts.
descriptors.D8_geometry_only_edge_xor: Symmetric difference of geometry-only edges defined by common_rms <= 0.10 in each endpoint set; objective values are not part of this descriptor.

materiality_rule.localized_only: Neither median gate is material, but one or more individual D1 or D5 values exceed 0.10; this is reported but does not rehabilitate a global non-portability claim.
materiality_rule.why_0_10: The threshold is inherited unchanged from the Q031 preregistered common-endpoint collapse RMS and is fixed before Q036 endpoint output is inspected.

decision_rule.A: If mandatory gates pass and location_material OR shape_material is true: MATERIAL_REPRODUCIBLE_COMMON_GEOMETRY_DIFFERENCE. Q031 implementation-specific non-portability is rehabilitated only in this narrowed common-geometry sense; no physical Planck systematic is inferred.
decision_rule.B: If mandatory gates pass and both location_material and shape_material are false: NO_MATERIAL_GLOBAL_COMMON_GEOMETRY_DIFFERENCE_ESTABLISHED. Q031 PORTABILITY_FAILS / implementation-specific geometry inference must be further downgraded or replaced. Localized differences, if any, are retained descriptively.
decision_rule.C: If authoritative endpoints, exact Q031 locked scales, identity mapping, or mandatory validation cannot be reconstructed: INCONCLUSIVE with the missing information named explicitly.
